premises.statement: Guide events with null account_id need not participate in the null-account first-seen group when computing count_first_time_accounts.
premises.alternative: The guide daily specification says "rows without account_id are treated as one null account" and defines count_first_time_accounts as counting visitors whose account first appeared that day.
premises.reason: Ordinary equality does not match null accounts, changing first-time and returning metrics if such staging rows exist.

premises.statement: An unconvertible response on the selected latest NPS event should produce a null rating rather than a conversion error or selection of a different event.
premises.alternative: The specification requires "poll_response converted to integer (NULL if poll_response is NULL)" but does not authorize nullifying non-null unconvertible responses.
premises.reason: This silently determines the treatment of malformed latest responses and their contribution to NPS aggregates.
